Calendar 2026–27

We have regular meetings on Wednesdays during school term time. At each meeting there is teaching of either Chess or Go, followed by time for friendly games of whichever game you please. Club members also participate in local events and tournaments, which are included in the calendar below. Newcomers are welcome at any regular club meeting.

Spring and summer term club meeting dates are to be confirmed.

We are entirely run by volunteers (including parents) and we really welcome help to make the club run as smoothly as possible. That includes parents helping out on the desk at the start of sessions, and helping to put tables out at the start and clearing away at the end.

If you would like any more information or have suggestions please email us at cambridgechessgo@gmail.com.
